arms: Resume from the same checkpoint with a fresh attempt and identical information
Resume from the same checkpoint with the failed-check name only; no answer or patch disclosure
claim_boundary: Proposed same-operator engineering comparison only; no experiment has begun and no O benefit or independent evaluation is claimed.
entry_gate: Root must first identify a new bounded eligible repository/task source and demonstrate that its required baseline tests run with installed distribution metadata before freezing the behavioral trial. If that gate fails, preserve NOT_EVALUABLE and select another safe unit without reopening a closed trial.
fixed_design: At the next Root, preregister8 new public repository regression tasks selected by immutable stable IDs and environment reproducibility, without outcome filtering, plus one explicitly constructed no-fault control for each. Freeze16 case IDs, tests, task snapshots and budgets before any semantic arm. These controls are declared engineering cases, not independent production evidence.
integrity: Preregister exact versions, seeds/order, arm budgets and stopping rules; preserve all arms and negative results. If sequential same-operator context can leak answers, mark that dependence and do not claim independent evaluation. Do not change active prompts or reuse closed Click/Twisted/ARC/forecast/planning trials.
measurement: One finalized outcome per case/arm; grade all16 with the same immutable tests, account for every missing result, and report baseline failure prevalence, recovered failures, disrupted baseline successes and net task success. Separate original faults and no-fault controls.
objective: Measure O task recovery and damage to initially correct work using an unchanged baseline, resampling control and a localized corrective hint.
why: The observed author repair advantage concerns failed episodes. The missing healthy intervention denominator is the most direct unanswered safety/benefit question; another detection-only score cannot answer it.
